name: Quick Entry & Productivity
notes: Adds a universal Quick Add menu, synchronized expense templates, global search, advanced expense filters, bulk category and paid-account corrections, duplicate-last-month entry, recent-account suggestions, recently edited records, multi-step undo history, keyboard shortcuts, and iPhone bottom-sheet forms while preserving Finance Schema 12, Cloud Schema V2, Ledger Version 1, Budget Version 1, and Insights Version 1.
